questions.question: Who was forced to resign as U.S. ambassador to Greece following allegations involving donors, business interests, and luxury travel?
options: Kimberly Guilfoyle
Shirley Weber
Amy Gleason
Katie Zacharia
questions.explanation: The White House forced Kimberly Guilfoyle to resign after a donor alleged she sought payment of a $100,000 credit card bill in exchange for access. She denied wrongdoing, and the State Department inspector general was examining the allegations.

questions.question: How much Russian diesel was expected to be supplied immediately under Trump’s deal with Putin?
options: More than 1 million tons
More than 30,000 tons
More than 100,000 tons
More than 300,000 tons
questions.explanation: Russia was expected to supply more than 300,000 tons immediately, with additional shipments planned in the following months.

questions.question: What was the year-over-year U.S. inflation rate in September?
questions.explanation: U.S. inflation reached 3.7% from a year earlier and rose 0.6% from August. Gas prices jumped 9.1% and accounted for more than half of the monthly increase.

questions.question: Why did Los Angeles County Registrar Dean Logan say his office had not accessed the Justice Department’s thumb drive containing a voter list?
options: Using it would conflict with privacy and security protocols because it was not considered secure
A federal judge prohibited the county from reviewing it
The Justice Department had withdrawn the list
The drive arrived after the deadline for reviewing ballots
questions.explanation: Logan said accessing the device would conflict with established data privacy and information security protocols. The password-protected drive arrived with its password handwritten on a sticky note attached to the letter.

questions.question: Why did the Trump administration argue that DOGE was exempt from federal public-records laws?
options: DOGE had been dissolved before receiving any records requests
DOGE was an independent agency outside the executive branch
DOGE handled only classified military intelligence
DOGE was merely a presidential advisory body
questions.explanation: The administration characterized DOGE as a presidential advisory body and therefore exempt from public-records laws. The Supreme Court agreed to hear its effort to withhold DOGE records sought under the Freedom of Information Act.

questions.question: What happened hours after Trump declared that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an “energy ceasefire”?
options: The Treasury Department ended its waiver for Russian diesel
Ukraine and Russia signed a permanent peace agreement
Russia attacked Ukraine’s energy infrastructure
Moscow formally confirmed the ceasefire
questions.explanation: Russian drones struck a gas production facility and at least five other energy-related targets in Ukraine. Moscow had not confirmed Trump’s claimed agreement, and Volodymyr Zelensky said he learned about it through the media.

questions.question: What is projected to happen if Social Security’s retirement trust fund runs out in 2032 and Congress does not act?
options: The 3.6% cost-of-living increase will be canceled
Retirement benefits will automatically be cut by 22%
The retirement age will automatically rise
Average monthly benefits will fall by exactly $75
questions.explanation: Exhaustion of the retirement trust fund would trigger an automatic 22% reduction in retirement benefits unless Congress intervenes.

questions.question: At least how much of the $333 million committed to Trump’s White House ballroom came from donors who requested anonymity?
options: $10 million
$77 million
$25 million
$333 million
questions.explanation: At least $77 million came from donors who requested anonymity. Internal records also showed that companies and executives holding federal contracts accounted for about half of the total commitments.
